lines: THE VILLAIN DRAWN TO SELL TOYS

segments.text: For twenty-three years, no other comic company could legally put the word zombie on a cover. Marvel owned it.
But somewhere in the paperwork, they file to trademark the word itself. Not a character. Not a logo. The actual word zombie, for comic magazines.
Doesn't matter — the trademark's live. Any other publisher wanting a zombie comic has to dance around the word entirely. Different title. Different cover language. Anything but the Z-word.
1996. Someone finally files to cancel it. Marvel loses the word — twenty-three years after filing it for a horror comic almost nobody remembers.
